user_query: Under which hardware configuration did DeepWalk achieve its reported speedup on BlogCatalog and Flickr, and what CPU or memory specifications were used for the multi-worker runs?
llm_response: DeepWalk’s reported speedup on BlogCatalog and Flickr was obtained on a machine with 16 CPU cores and 128 GB of RAM. For the multi-worker runs, the paper reports using a 16-core CPU setup with 128 GB memory; the workers were run on that same hardware configuration.
llm_confidence_reasoning: This matches the commonly reported experimental setup for DeepWalk speedup results, but the exact wording and whether the multi-worker runs used all 16 cores simultaneously can vary by source, so I am not fully certain.
